about: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Lydie & Suelle" is the 3rd instalment: after discovering a mysterious painting, Lydie & Suelle get closer to their dream of running the best atelier.
summary: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs!
